name: 使用高级执行的服务 (6AU)
description_en_html:
Overview

Service with Advanced Execution is a service offered by a service provider and agreed upon by the service recipient towards the maintenance of technical objects whenever a breakdown, failure or malfunction occurs. This process can start with or without a quotation. At the core of this process is the service order that represents the commercial aspects together with the corresponding maintenance order that enables the planning and execution of the service.

The process is performed using the steps of quotation planning, service execution, and billing.

Key Process Flow

  • Create service quotation
  • Create follow-up service order after acceptance of quotation by customer
  • Release the execution order item in the service order and generate execution order
  • Release the execution order
  • Create maintenance confirmation
  • Complete the maintenance order technically
  • Create debit memo request
  • Create billing document
  • Perform business completion of the execution order

Business Benefits

  • Use an end-to-end process for service management with advanced execution, from quote to order to billing and accounting.
  • Plan and execute the service via follow-up execution order.
  • Perform billing using the resource-related billing via dynamic item processing
  • Integrate with item-based accounting for service management where service items are recognized as account assignment objects
description_zh_html:
概览

使用高级执行的服务 是由服务提供者提供并由服务接收方商定的服务，用于在发生故障、故障时维护技术对象。此流程可以在有或没有报价的情况下开始。此流程的核心是服务订单，代表商业方面以及支持计划和执行服务的相应维护订单。

该流程使用报价计划、服务执行和开票步骤执行。

关键流程流

  • 创建服务报价
  • 在客户接受报价后，创建后续服务订单
  • 下达服务订单中的执行订单项目，并生成执行订单
  • 下达执行订单
  • 创建维护确认
  • 技术上完成维护订单
  • 创建借项凭证请求
  • 创建开票凭证
  • 执行执行订单的业务完成

业务优势

  • 从报价到订单，再到开票和会计核算，使用具有高级执行功能的端到端服务管理流程。
  • 通过后续执行订单计划和执行服务。
  • 通过动态项目处理，使用资源相关开票执行开票
  • 与服务管理的基于项目的会计核算集成，其中服务项目被识别为科目分配对象
